figures.name: assets/spring-frozen-valley-vegetation.jpg
figures.caption: Plant details are almost swallowed by the blue-gray valley: atmosphere reduces depth and certainty.

figures.name: assets/spring-shepherd-girl-with-staff.jpg
figures.caption: The staff is visible before its ritual function becomes clear, linking an ordinary traveler’s tool to later communication.

figures.name: assets/spring-ancient-spirit-scale.jpg
figures.caption: The spirit dwarfs the human figure; its physical scale gives a small gesture extraordinary stakes.

figures.name: assets/spring-mountain-spirit-in-fog.jpg
figures.caption: The creature’s limbs and points of light emerge slowly from fog, making its form legible through movement rather than exposition.

figures.name: assets/spring-and-autumn-on-the-ridge.jpg
figures.caption: Autumn’s smaller movements and recognizable canine behavior provide a familiar scale beside the fantastical creatures.

figures.name: assets/spring-spirit-and-shepherd-staff.jpg
figures.caption: The gap between the small staff and the enormous spirit turns the musical exchange into a visible negotiation.

figures.name: assets/spring-first-glowing-chime.jpg
figures.caption: The small illuminated chime makes an otherwise invisible exchange tangible and gives viewers a precise object to track.

figures.name: inline_html_diagram
figures.caption: Interpretive model of how a musical exchange becomes a concrete task; not a shot from the film.

figures.name: assets/spring-lifting-staff-through-fog.jpg
figures.caption: The glowing staff provides a clear point of orientation amid the spirits and the fog.

figures.name: assets/spring-displaced-blue-chime.jpg
figures.caption: By isolating the chime in a sparse composition, the film makes the vulnerable object the center of suspense.

figures.name: assets/spring-red-chime-and-expression.jpg
figures.caption: Spring’s facial expression and the bright chime communicate thought and intention without spoken dialogue.

figures.name: assets/spring-clouds-opening-over-mountains.jpg
figures.caption: The contrast of expansive sunlit peaks and obscured valley makes weather a measure of narrative scale.

figures.name: inline_html_diagram
figures.caption: A model of the changing scale of narrative consequence, from a small gesture to the transformed valley.

figures.name: assets/spring-first-flowers-return.jpg
figures.caption: The close-up of flowering plants makes seasonal renewal visible through small material details.
